latestVersion.changelog:
Text to Video Chinese AI — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 1080p AI videos from Chinese text prompts; supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, and SRT uploads up to 200MB.
- Automatic session setup with free 7-day/100-credit tokens for new users.
- Export high-quality MP4 videos with video, audio, and text tracks—optimized for Chinese social platforms.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline (30–90 seconds typical); supports batch and iterative workflows.
- Seamless command routing for exporting, checking credits, uploading, and session state.
- Clear error handling and guidance for file, token, and credit issues.
